assertions.claim: Divorce by agreement: within 30 days of filing either party may withdraw; after the period both must personally collect the divorce certificate within 30 days; not showing up counts as withdrawal
assertions.cn_span: 交了申请后 30 天内任何一方都能撤回，期满还要在 30 天内两人亲自去领离婚证，不去就当撤回

assertions.claim: If the other side disagrees, only litigation remains; the court mediates first
assertions.cn_span: 对方不同意只能起诉，法院先调解

assertions.claim: Divorce granted where there is remarriage or cohabitation with another, domestic violence/abuse/abandonment, uncorrected gambling or drug addiction, two years of separation — and mediation fails
assertions.cn_span: 要有重婚或与他人同居、家暴虐待遗弃、赌博吸毒屡教不改、分居满两年这些情形，调解不成才判离

assertions.claim: If after a denial they live apart another year, the second petition must be granted
assertions.cn_span: 判了不离再分居满一年，第二次起诉应当准予

assertions.claim: The cooling-off period applies only to divorce by agreement; litigation divorce has none but takes longer
assertions.cn_span: 冷静期只适用于协议离婚，诉讼离婚没有冷静期但周期更长

assertions.claim: Of the 3.513 million divorces in 2024, 0.891 million went through court judgment or mediation
assertions.cn_span: 2024 年全国离婚 351.3 万对里 89.1 万对走的是法院判决、调解
